title: Add whiteboard background templates (Blank / Dots / Grid / Lines) with create-board template picker and in-board toggle

requirements.text: Add a board background/template feature with the following modes: Blank, Dots, Grid, and Lines. The selected background must be stored as part of the board’s metadata and loaded for all collaborators when they open/join the board.

quotes: give more features like dot s grid lines blank etc

acceptanceCriteria: A board has a backgroundMode value that is one of: "blank" | "dots" | "grid" | "lines".
When two different clients open the same board, both see the same background mode.
Changing the background mode persists for the board and remains after refresh/reload.

requirements.text: Update the backend API and data model to include board metadata for background mode (and return it in snapshot/changes responses) without breaking existing board operations syncing.

quotes: give more features like dot s grid lines blank etc

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes snapshot (and incremental changes if applicable) that includes the board background mode in addition to operations and version.
If a board was created before this change, it defaults to background mode "blank" when fetched.
Existing drawing/collaboration features continue working unchanged (operations append, snapshot load, polling sync).

requirements.text: Implement background rendering on the canvas for Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines. The background must render behind all elements and respect the viewport pan/zoom so the pattern appears “anchored” to the world space (i.e., it doesn’t slide relative to drawings when panning/zooming).

quotes: give more features like dot s grid lines blank etc

acceptanceCriteria: Blank mode renders a clean solid background.
Dots mode renders an evenly-spaced dot pattern.
Grid mode renders evenly-spaced square grid lines.
Lines mode renders evenly-spaced horizontal ruled lines.
When the user pans/zooms, the background pattern stays aligned with the drawing world coordinates (no drifting relative to existing strokes/shapes).

requirements.text: Add a “Create New Board” modal that lets the user enter a board name and select a template (Blank / Dots / Grid / Lines), matching the intent of the uploaded screenshots (template tiles + primary “Create Board” action). Creating the board navigates into that board with the selected template applied.

quotes: give more features like dot s grid lines blank etc

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Create Board” on the home screen opens a modal with: board name input + template selection tiles (Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines) + Cancel + Create Board.
Create Board is disabled until a valid board name is entered (non-empty after trim).
After creating, the app navigates to the new board and the selected background is visible immediately.
Recent boards list continues to function.

requirements.text: Add an in-board UI control to switch the board background between Blank/Dots/Grid/Lines (for example in the top bar overflow menu or a small settings dropdown). Changing it updates the board metadata so all collaborators converge to the new background.

quotes: give more features like dot s grid lines blank etc

acceptanceCriteria: A user can change the background mode from within the board UI.
The change is persisted to the backend and is reflected on another client after sync/polling.
Switching background does not modify or delete existing whiteboard elements.

constraints: Respect the single-actor backend architecture; keep Motoko logic in backend/main.mo (generate backend/migration.mo only if an upgrade requires state migration).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
No WebSockets; continue using polling-based synchronization.
nonGoals: Adding new drawing tools beyond the existing toolset.
Adding external databases or third-party realtime services.
Implementing complex per-user background preferences (background is per-board, shared by collaborators).
